❓ Frequently asked questions

What is carb cycling?

Alternating high-carb days (around training) with low-carb days. Protein stays constant; carbs and fats trade off to hit the calorie target.

How is TDEE calculated?

BMR from the Mifflin-St Jeor equation (weight, height, age, sex) multiplied by an activity factor from 1.2 (sedentary) to 1.9 (very active).

Which days should be high carb?

Put high-carb days on your hardest training days and low-carb days on rest days.
